name: SentinelOne
description: SentinelOne Singularity is an endpoint, cloud, and identity security platform that runs behavioral and static AI detection models on a single on-device agent to prevent, detect, and autonomously respond to threats.
best_for: Security operations teams wanting autonomous, on-device threat detection and one-click remediation across endpoints, cloud workloads, and identity systems.
features: Behavioral AI and static AI models running on-device to detect ransomware, malware, and zero-day threats
Autonomous, machine-speed prevention that can kill and quarantine unauthorized processes without waiting on a cloud round-trip
Patented 1-click rollback to restore an endpoint to its pre-attack state
Purple AI natural-language threat hunting with AI-generated event summaries
Singularity Mobile detection for mobile phishing, malware, and zero-day exploits
Cloud security and identity protection alongside core endpoint protection
Managed Threat Hunting and Identity Detection & Response on higher tiers
pros: Publishes list pricing per endpoint (uncommon among EDR/XDR vendors) with named tiers
Behavioral and static AI models run on-device, so prevention does not depend on a live cloud connection
Patented 1-click rollback for fast recovery after an attack
cons: Listed prices are not final — actual pricing is agreed through an authorized SentinelOne partner
No free trial disclosed on the pricing page
The top Singularity Enterprise tier, including its Agentic AI SOC Analyst feature, is quote-only

tiers.name: Singularity Complete
tiers.notes: For 5-100 workstations. Includes AI-driven protection, real-time threat detection, 14-day data retention, and the AI Security Assistant. Final pricing is agreed through an authorized SentinelOne partner and may differ from this list price.

tiers.name: Singularity Commercial
tiers.notes: For 5-100 workstations. Adds Identity Detection & Response, 90-day data retention, and Managed Threat Hunting. Final pricing is agreed through an authorized SentinelOne partner.

tiers.name: Singularity Enterprise
tiers.notes: Contact sales for pricing. Adds an Agentic AI SOC Analyst, full visibility and forensics, and expert-led onboarding.

alternatives.name: CrowdStrike
alternatives.description: An AI-native cybersecurity platform unifying endpoint detection and response, cloud security, and identity protection.
alternatives.best_for: Security teams wanting a unified EDR/XDR platform with published starting list pricing and a next-gen SIEM.
strengths: Identity protection across human, non-human, and AI identities

alternatives.name: Wiz
alternatives.description: An AI-powered cloud security platform providing posture management, vulnerability scanning, and workload protection.
alternatives.best_for: Security teams whose priority is cloud-native posture management and agentless scanning rather than endpoint-agent-based EDR.
